FOUNDERS OF CARPE DIEMDANAI MARIA KANDILIOTI & ARISTOTELIS ZOGKOS

Danai Maria Kandilioti

Psychologist – Cognitive Behavioural Psychotherapist (MSc)
Founder · CBT

Danai Maria Kandilioti is a Psychologist – Cognitive Behavioural Psychotherapist (MSc) and the founder of the Carpe Diem Psychotherapy Centre, with practices in central Athens, Piraeus and Peristeri.

She has many years of clinical experience and has trained in modern, evidence-based therapeutic approaches, with Cognitive Behavioural Therapy at the core, in which she completed long-term training. Her work focuses particularly on anxiety disorders, eating disorders, and mood and personality disorders.

Guided by empathy, respect and a safe therapeutic relationship, her aim is to help every person understand themselves, feel stronger and genuinely improve their quality of life.

Services

Psychotherapy & Counselling Services

Comprehensive therapeutic approaches for adults, couples and families.

01

Individual Psychotherapy for Adults

Working with anxiety, mood & personality.

  • Anxiety disorders (generalised anxiety, panic attacks, phobias)
  • Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
  • Mood disorders (depression, bipolar disorder)
  • Personality disorders
  • Low self-esteem & self-image difficulties
  • Eating disorders & psychotic syndromes
  • Anger management & addictions
  • Body dysmorphic disorders
02

Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)

Restructuring thoughts & changing behaviour.

  • Recognising and restructuring unhelpful thoughts
  • Learning about cognitive errors & psychoeducation
  • Breaking the vicious cycles that keep problems going
  • Understanding how behaviour, thoughts and emotions interact
  • Changing unhelpful patterns
  • Linking the past & trauma with the present
  • Training in practical CBT exercises
03

Couples Therapy

Strengthening communication and emotional connection.

  • Better communication and emotional connection
  • Handling conflict
  • Working through crises in the relationship
  • Building trust and cooperation
  • Support through transitions (parenthood, life changes)
04

Parent Counselling

Support in the parenting role & the family.

  • Strengthening parenting skills
  • Managing the behaviour of children and teenagers
  • Understanding the child's emotional needs
  • Boundaries, communication and roles in the family
  • Supporting parents through demanding stages of development
05

Counselling & Psychoeducation

Crisis support & professional empowerment.

  • Support with difficult decisions and life changes
  • Crisis management
  • Business counselling (HR)
  • Empowerment and self-awareness
06

Ways to have therapy

Flexible session options for every need.

  • In person: Exarcheia, Piraeus, Peristeri
  • Online psychotherapy (Zoom, Viber, Skype)
  • Home-visit psychotherapy

The team

The Carpe Diem team

Δανάη Οικονόμου

MSc Κλινική Νευροψυχολογία

Η Δανάη Οικονόμου, απόφοιτη Ψυχολογίας ΕΚΠΑ με MSc στην Κλινική Νευροψυχολογία, έχει εκπαιδευτεί στη Γνωσιακή Ψυχοθεραπεία (EABCT) και στην Κλινική Ψυχοπαθολογία («Παναγιώτης Ουλής»).

Danai Oikonomou

MSc Clinical Neuropsychology

Danai Oikonomou, a Psychology graduate of the University of Athens (NKUA) with an MSc in Clinical Neuropsychology, has trained in Cognitive Psychotherapy (EABCT) and in Clinical Psychopathology («Panagiotis Oulis»).

Angeliki Apostolopoulou

CBT · Dance therapy

Angeliki Apostolopoulou, a Psychology graduate of NKUA with an MSc from the Athens Medical School, is trained in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (EABCT) and Dance Therapy.

Sofia Bourelaki

Teenagers & adults

Sofia Bourelaki holds an MSc in Psychology (Crete) and in Social Psychology (Lancaster), has trained in Cognitive Psychotherapy and has experience supporting teenagers and adults.

Rafail Simosis

Anxiety & phobias

Rafail Simosis, a top-of-class Psychology graduate of NKUA with an MSc from the Medical School of Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, has trained in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (EABCT) with a focus on anxiety and phobias.

Silia Venetsanou

MSc CBT (UCLan)

Silia Venetsanou, a Psychology graduate of NKUA with an MSc in Cognitive Behavioural Psychotherapy (UCLan), has completed a placement in rTMS therapy and many related trainings.

Anastasia Mentzelidi

MSc King’s College

Anastasia Mentzelidi, a Psychology graduate (Sheffield) with an MSc in Affective Disorders (King’s College), is trained in CBT (EABCT) with clinical experience in Greece and the UK.

Eleni Sinanou

MSc Clinical Psychology

Eleni Sinanou, a Psychology graduate of NKUA with an MSc in Applied Clinical Psychology (UCLan), has trained in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (EABCT).

Viki Afentoulidou

Children · teens · adults

Viki Afentoulidou, a Psychology graduate of Aristotle University of Thessaloniki trained in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, offers psychological support to children, teenagers and adults.

Melitini Sifaki

Adults & vulnerable groups

Melitini Sifaki holds a BSc in Psychology from the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens and has trained in Cognitive–Behavioural Psychotherapy. She has also attended training seminars across the wider field of mental health and, in the course of her career, has gained experience in providing psychological support to adults and to vulnerable groups.

ΝΠ

Niki Panagopoulou

Aiginiteio · EPIPSY

Niki Panagopoulou holds a BSc in Psychology from the University of Crete and an MSc from the Athens Medical School. She has trained in Cognitive Behavioural Psychotherapy (EPIPSY) and is also a scientific associate of the Psychometric Laboratory of the 1st University Psychiatric Clinic at Aiginiteio Hospital.

3 Keys for Getting Through a Hard Day

You are not the only one who bends under pressure. In this video we look at three pillars of composure:

1
Acceptance:You have the right to feel bad, without guilt.
2
Coping:Recall a small "win" or a habit that calms you.
3
Perspective:Tomorrow is a new day.
